record.support_text: The oral bioavailability for 3-methoxypterostilbene was determined to be 50.6%0020 ± 10.0%, with pharmacokinetic parameters summarized for an IV dose of 10 mg/kg and a PO dose of 100 mg/kg.

expected.support_text: The oral bioavailability for 3-methoxypterostilbene was determined to be 50.6%0020 ± 10.0%, with pharmacokinetic parameters summarized for an IV dose of 10 mg/kg and a PO dose of 100 mg/kg.

validation.note: The literal 0020 is an encoded space concatenated inside measurement_text. Decoding it restores one atomic mean-plus-variation measurement while the source support sentence remains unchanged.

record.support_text: The oral bioavailability of amiodarone is 35%50%, which is described as low and variable.

expected.support_text: The oral bioavailability of amiodarone is 35%50%, which is described as low and variable.

validation.note: The reviewed paper value is the interval 35%-50%. Restoring the separator in measurement_text preserves the range for display while support_text remains source-faithful and finite_scalar_value stays null.
A nonzero three-digit comma group is a valid thousands spelling. The source cleaner must not reinterpret it as a decimal, while the scalar parser may fold it to 2180.

record.measurement_text: 50-60% increase in epidermal thickness for antipsoriatic active derivatives including 1,25(OH)2D3.

expected.measurement_text: 50-60% increase in epidermal thickness for antipsoriatic active derivatives including 1,25(OH)2D3.
expected.canonical_measurement: 50-60% increase in epidermal thickness for antipsoriatic active derivatives including 1,25(OH)2D3.

validation.note: A numeric range at the beginning must not authorize comma rewriting later in free text. The later 1,25 token is part of the vitamin-D derivative name and must remain unchanged.
Without an exact reviewed repair, adjacent percent-bearing numbers are ambiguous. The generic cleaner must not guess a separator and the parser must fail closed rather than concatenate them.
